scope: Bounded research smoke of the discovery -> evidence -> reproduce pipeline on the real local XAUUSD H1 store. Pipeline behaviour only; not validation, not promotion evidence.

environment.polars_threads: default (unpinned) for discovery and the first evidence/reproduce attempts; pinned to 1 for the recorded bundle and the passing reproduce

commands.discovery_run: cd <research worktree> && PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src <venv>/python -m scalping.cli discovery run --root /Users/resul2004/Documents/ai-scalping-studio/.worktrees/v1/data-ticks5-store --symbol XAUUSD --timeframe H1 --max-trials 25 --population 8 --generations 4 --seed 7 --archive runs/discovery/xauusd-h1-seed7.sqlite --out runs/discovery/xauusd-h1-seed7.run.json --no-cache
commands.discovery_run_repeat: same command with --archive runs/discovery/repro/xauusd-h1-seed7.sqlite --out runs/discovery/repro/xauusd-h1-seed7.run.json (empty archive, same seed)
commands.reproduce_pinned: POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src <venv>/python -m scalping.cli discovery reproduce --bundle runs/discovery/evidence/most-active.evidence.json --store-root runs/discovery/store --out runs/discovery/evidence/most-active.reproduce.threads1.json
commands.reproduce_default_threads: same reproduce command without POLARS_MAX_THREADS, run twice

best_candidate.reason_flat: flat on the validation slice: 0 closed trades with a 1-bar holding limit
best_candidate.canonical_summary: not LONG between(m15_rsi_14, -0.7993, 1.4942); exits (change(london,6) != eq_low_20) AND NOT fall(asia,13), or fall(order_block_dist_atr,9); holding 1 bar; sizing atr_multiple 1.98

discovery_run.decision_reason: candidate ebb1d79d3a06 is flat by construction (0 closed trades); NO TRADE is the recorded result

evidence_bundle.producer: scalping.discovery.evidence.build_evidence (no persist module for CandidateEvidence exists in this tree; bundle written as JSON + spec sidecar under runs/, gitignored)

best_candidate_attempt.message: fold_trades_below_minimum: fold 1 closed 0 trades; the policy requires 5
best_candidate_attempt.meaning: fail-closed behaviour: a flat candidate cannot produce promotion evidence

most_active_candidate.note: Highest-trade accepted candidate in the archive; used only to exercise the evidence and reproduce plumbing. It is not the run winner and not a candidate for promotion.

default_threads.observed_difference: last-bit float drift in regime sums, e.g. folds[2].regimes[0].net_profit -300.7723024042524 vs -300.77230240425234 (~1e-16 relative)
default_threads.interpretation: polars group-by summation order under the default thread pool is not pinned; each unpinned run produced a different checksum. The mismatch was reported and exit code was 1, never a silent pass.

search_level.second_seeded_run_on_empty_archive: identical dataset_id, trials 22, skipped 3, accepted 22, decision no_trade, best candidate id ebb1d79d3a06..., identical best metrics and identical baseline table

limitations: 25 attempts (22 evaluated, 3 skipped before the evaluator) over a 4,428-bar validation slice is a wiring smoke, not a search. The multiple-testing denominator is 22 evaluations.
Gate defaults are all zero/empty, so all 22 evaluated candidates were accepted; 'accepted' here carries no quality meaning.

Selection metric is net_profit and the gate is empty: a flat candidate scores exactly 0.0 and ranks first whenever every trading candidate loses. The run's 'best' candidate is such a degenerate no-trade tree.
Validation slice only. The test split was never read or scored; there is no walk-forward, no locked OOS and no regime stability proof. Discovery cannot and did not promote.
The most-active candidate is a known validation loser (724 trades, -2006.07 net). Its evidence bundle exists to exercise the folds/stress/reproduce path, not to propose a policy.

Regime-level sums are not bit-reproducible under polars' default thread pool: two unpinned reproduce runs returned different checksums with ~1e-16 relative differences. Pinning POLARS_MAX_THREADS=1 makes bundle and reproduce agree exactly.
One store, one symbol, one timeframe (XAUUSD H1 derived from ticks5). No conclusion generalises beyond this store.
No CandidateEvidence persist module exists in this tree; bundles live as JSON plus a spec sidecar under runs/ and are not committed.
Folds use min_trades_per_fold=5 and an iid bootstrap CI; iid resampling ignores trade clustering, so the interval can look tighter than the sequence supports.
conclusion: On the real local XAUUSD H1 store the pipeline ran end to end: seeded search (22 evaluations), a recorded no_trade decision, a fail-closed evidence refusal for the flat best candidate, a built bundle for an archive candidate, and a reproduce pass with the thread pool pinned. No candidate showed an edge. The single validation-slice search winner is a degenerate flat policy, and the one bundled candidate has a negative expectancy interval. This is pipeline evidence only; no promotion was attempted and no claim of validation or profitability is made.
